messages:
jamal (newhire): hi all, first day here. accepted the GitHub invite but the org doesnt appear on my profile. clicking the invite link opens a page that says \"you need to enable 2FA\" and the flow asks for recovery codes i never generated. any quick fixes?
it-support: welcome jamal! usually that happens if you accepted the invite with a different GH account or the invite expired. what email did you accept with and what is your GitHub username?
jamal (newhire): accepted with jamal+redwood@gmail.com, username is jamalz. browser shows im already signed into my personal account too.
rachel (devex): tip: sign out of other accounts or open the invite link in an incognito window. after you accept, GH will prompt to connect SSO -> then require 2FA. create TOTP then generate recovery codes immediately.
it-support: resending invite now. also if you see \"Organization requires SAML SSO\" click Connect SSO and sign in with your work SSO. if 2FA flow is stuck send a DM with your GH username and we can force an admin resend that includes the SSO handshake.
onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable 2FA + save recovery codes 4) Add SSH key -> https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
jamal (newhire): tried in incognito, enabled TOTP with Google Authenticator, saved recovery codes. connected SSO but when i try to add my SSH key GH shows a permission denied when cloning later.
it-support: did you add the public key to your account? run `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste into Settings -> SSH and GPG keys. confirm you cloned with the ssh url `git@github.com:redwood-inference/inference-runtime.git`.
jamal (newhire): added key and can list it in settings. clone still fails: \"Permission denied (publickey)\"
nina (manager): cc @it-support and @sec-bot. jamal will need repo access to inference-runtime and model-onboarding. happy to approve.
sec-bot: Security note: we grant default read+PR to new engineering hires. elevated push to main requires 2FA, manager approval, and short security training. nina please reply with approval for infra or elevated access.
it-support: looks like your local ssh agent might not be forwarding the key. run `ssh -T git@github.com` and if it fails try `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` then retry. also ensure your key type is supported (ed25519 preferred).
jamal (newhire): `ssh -T` succeeded after `ssh-add`. now i can clone. thanks!
rachel (devex): added a quick snippet to the onboarding docs for anyone who hits the same ssh-agent issue: https://redwood.example.com/docs/onboarding/ssh-troubleshoot
onboard-bot: Automated: added jamal to team \"eng-ml\" with read+PR on public repos. infra access pending manager approval.
nina (manager): i approve read access to inference-runtime and model-onboarding for jamal for ramping week.
sec-bot: infra-readers access granted. to request push rights file the short form at https://redwood.example.com/security/priv-req and include manager sign-off.
jamal (newhire): all good now 44d can clone, open PRs, and i see eng-ml team membership. thanks for the help!
it-support: closing thread 4cc if anything else, ping #help or DM us.
